subject: Small favor for Thursday garden supply
text: Hope your week’s going okay so far. I had one quick, slightly awkward question about the community garden schedule, and I figured you’d be the best person to ask because you always know how the crews line up. On Thursday, I’m supposed to bring the extra watering cans, but the van in my street is being worked on until about noon. I could take two cans at a time in the back seat, but I’m worried we’ll be short for the planting table if I’m later than planned. Also, if there’s any chance the seed packets were moved again, a quick photo of the cabinet door would save me from hunting through the wrong bin. I know that’s a random favor, and I’ll repay it with snacks at the next cleanup day. Please ignore this if you’re swamped. Would you mind asking the logistics team if they can keep a spare set at the shed for Thursday morning? Totally understand if that’s a hassle. If they can’t, do you think it would be okay for me to pick up the cans an hour early from the storage unit? I can bring coffee as a small thank-you, assuming you’re already caffeinated or will be by mid-morning. No rush—just let me know when you have a minute. Thanks so much for helping me sort this out. Best,
